title: mesh-bus-ingress-tcp
description: Config for a plain TCP ingress listener with a fixed upstream target. Constructed by mesh-bus-runtime from IngressCfg::Tcp.

listen.description: host:port to bind the TCP listener.

target.description: Fixed upstream host:port all sessions are forwarded to.

socket_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_RCVBUF size in bytes for accepted TCP sockets.

socket_send_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_SNDBUF size in bytes for accepted TCP sockets.

client_eof_semantics.description: After client read EOF, ingress calls StreamSendHalf::shutdown_write and keeps reading upstream returns until FIN.
